refund the October 13 charge as a one-time exception

facts.text: This is Vercel's billing support team; Mia writes to them about charges on her Vercel account.

evidence.quote: Hello Vercel Billing Team,

facts.text: In October 2024 Mia was charged twice ($20.00 each) for the same Pro plan period (October 7 to November 6, 2024).

evidence.quote: Both charges are $20.00
both cover October 7 to November 6, 2024

facts.text: Mia's Vercel account had only one team and one seat at that time.

evidence.quote: My account has only one team and one seat

facts.text: Mia asked them to check that the subscription was not set up twice, and to confirm she would only be billed once from then on.

evidence.quote: check that the subscription is not set up twice
I will only be billed once going forward

facts.text: In October 2024 Mia agreed to have the duplicate charge refunded to her card on file.

evidence.quote: please refund it to the card on file

facts.text: Mia downgraded her team to the Hobby plan on September 20, 2025.

evidence.quote: Hobby plan on September 20, 2025

facts.text: On October 13, 2025 Mia was still charged $20.00 for the Web Analytics Plus and Speed Insights add-ons after the downgrade. She had not known the add-ons would stay active.

evidence.quote: Web Analytics Plus and Speed Insights
I did not know these add-ons would stay active

facts.text: Mia had not deployed any project since the downgrade. She asked for both add-ons to be removed and for a one-time exception refund.

evidence.quote: I have not deployed any project since the downgrade
Please remove both add-ons

facts.text: In October 2025 Mia agreed to have the refund sent to her original payment method.

evidence.quote: the original payment method is fine

facts.text: Mia's style with them: she states the facts with exact dates and amounts, then asks them to confirm the refund amount and that no further charges will be made. Her follow-up replies are one line.

evidence.quote: Please confirm that the add-ons are removed
Please confirm the amount being refunded
